Future<bool> more(int i) async => i < 3;
Future<void> save(int i) async {}
void use(int i) {}
Future<void> f_var1_cond_semi(int n) async {
  for (var i = 0; await more(i); i++);
}
Future<void> f_var1_cond_empty(int n) async {
  for (var i = 0; await more(i); i++) {}
}
Future<void> f_var1_cond_stmt(int n) async {
  for (var i = 0; await more(i); i++) { use(i); }
}
Future<void> f_var1_upd_semi(int n) async {
  for (var i = 0; i < n; await save(i), i++);
}

  for (var i = 0; i < n; await save(i), i++) {}
}

  for (var i = 0; i < n; await save(i), i++) { use(i); }
}
